import os,re,json
p='inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw';need=[b'CREATE TABLE',b'create table'];sz=os.path.getsize(p);chunk=16*1024*1024;overlap=8192;hits=[];seen=set()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 base=0;tail=b''
 while True:
  x=f.read(chunk)
  if not x:break
  b=tail+x;start=base-len(tail)
  lo=b.lower();pos=0
  while True:
   i=lo.find(b'create table',pos)
   if i<0:break
   off=start+i;pos=i+12
   if off in seen:continue
   seen.add(off)
   a=max(0,i-2048);z=min(len(b),i+6144);c=b[a:z]
   runs=[m.group().decode('latin1','replace') for m in re.finditer(rb'[\x20-\x7e\r\n\t]{8,}',c)]
   text=' | '.join(runs)
   keywords={k:(k in text.lower()) for k in ['dropbox','email','contact','private','client','key','identity','host','account','user']}
   hits.append({'offset':off,'keywords':[k for k,v in keywords.items() if v],'context':text[:20000]})
  tail=b[-overlap:];base+=len(x)
json.dump({'size':sz,'hit_count':len(hits),'hits':hits},open(os.environ['OUT']+'/create-table-contexts.json','w'),indent=2)
rank=[h for h in hits if set(h['keywords']) & {'dropbox','email','contact','private','client','identity'}]
json.dump(rank,open(os.environ['OUT']+'/create-table-ranked.json','w'),indent=2)
print('hits',len(hits),'ranked',len(rank));
for h in rank[:80]:print(h['offset'],h['keywords'],h['context'][:500].replace('\n',' '))
